selection: For each held-out title, choose the single weight with lowest mean exact played-texture error on the other seven titles; report the held-out error without refitting.
purpose: test whether one transferable covariance weight compensates the stable normative texture response
interpretation_guards: Variance always uses the full source-minus-base target; the grid changes only AR covariance shape.
Per-title best weights are descriptive and may not justify code. Only leave-one-title-out selection counts as transfer evidence.
Four-seed exact replay has a measurable floor; a selected setting must be rerun at 16 seeds before a CUDA prototype.
Weight zero is the full-source covariance control and weight one is the physical covariance-difference model.
